value.doc: The larger of an amount and zero.

(14.6) Eligible Liquid Assets: the asset's code is in Tier 1, 2 or 3 and it is under
liquidity desk control.
Excess over tier limits = Tier 2 and 3 limit excess + Tier 3 limit excess.

Stock of eligible liquid assets = Tier 1 + .80 × Tier 2 + .40 × Tier 3 − excess over tier
limits.
The asset's market value when it counts toward Tier 1, else zero.
Tier 1 value: total market value of the eligible Tier 1 assets.
Tier 2 and 3 limit excess = MAX[ 0, .80 × Tier 2 + .40 × Tier 3 − .8182 × Tier 1 ].
Tier 2 and 3 limit factor: .8182 of Tier 1, so Tiers 2 and 3 are at most 45% of the stock.
The asset's market value when it counts toward Tier 2, else zero.
Tier 2 value: total market value of the eligible Tier 2 assets.
Tier 2 weight: .80 (LRR Calculation).

Tier 3 limit excess = MAX[ 0, .40 × Tier 3 − Tier 2 and 3 limit excess
− .1111 × (Tier 1 + .80 × Tier 2) ].

Tier 3 limit factor: .1111 of Tier 1 and weighted Tier 2, so Tier 3 is at most 10% of the
stock.
The asset's market value when it counts toward Tier 3, else zero.
Tier 3 value: total market value of the eligible Tier 3 assets.
Tier 3 weight: .40 (LRR Calculation).
Overview: the tier an asset counts toward, or NotEligible when rule 14.6 excludes it.

The stock of eligible liquid assets, the LRR numerator (Rule 14, LRR Calculation), from
L.1 unrestricted assets selected by rule 14.6.

Asset codes from Schedule B. An `E` suffix means the asset meets all the asset-specific
tests of Rule 14.6.
The tier of the stock of eligible liquid assets an asset code belongs to.

Schedule B: which tier each asset code is in. Codes without the `E` suffix fail the Rule
14.6 tests, and municipal debt is never eligible.
The Asset Code field: the code of Schedule B, the asset code table.
One reported line of L.1: Unrestricted Assets.
Form PL-7 Part L: Liquid Assets, product L.1: Unrestricted Assets.
